instruction: Find the group travel booking page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the group travel booking page. Evaluator verifies URL contains both 'united.com' and 'group' patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements
Getter (active_tab_info) can successfully extract the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric function (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex to check if ALL required patterns ('united.com' and 'group') are present in the URL
Expected patterns are semantically correct: 'united.com' verifies correct domain, 'group' verifies the page is related to group travel
Complete coverage: both domain and topic requirements are verified
Logic will work correctly at runtime: returns 1.0 only if both patterns match, 0.0 if any pattern is missing
